policies.title: Egyptian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table says Egyptian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Egyptian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's table states that the visa can be obtained upon arrival and costs 40 JOD.
All non-Jordanian travellers must complete Gateway2Jordan registration and receive a QR code before departure.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, particular border-crossing restrictions and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Egyptian ordinary passports: Grenada arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked Embassy nationality schedule places Egypt in its Port of Entry cohort, defined as a visa granted on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Egyptian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Port of Entry as a visa granted on arrival in Grenada.
The schedule's April 2024 update remains actively linked by Grenada's Embassy; recheck if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.

policies.title: Egyptian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly places Egypt in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval unless the separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Egyptian passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Submit the authorized-visa application and listed documents before travel to the competent Panamanian consulate; the Embassy says approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Travel only after the consular visa has been granted and carry all required supporting documents.

policies.title: Egyptian ordinary passports: Mongolia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's official general rule requires a mission application for nationals outside the listed exemption and eVisa cohorts; Egypt is in neither current closed list.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Egyptian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Apply for the appropriate visitor visa through a Mongolian diplomatic mission before travel.
This conclusion combines Mongolia's stated general rule with its current closed exemption and eVisa lists; it does not infer a special-document or invitation route.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and exceptional on-arrival routes remain outside scope.

application.label: Mongolia general visitor-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Normally 3 working days; some applications may require 5–10 working days.
steps: Confirm that no listed visa exemption or eVisa eligibility applies.
Submit the temporary-visitor application and supporting documents at the nearest Mongolian diplomatic mission.
Obtain the visa before travelling to Mongolia.
